verdict.rationale:
Docusign ships multiple AI-generated insight/suggestion features on top of user data: AI-Assisted Review flags risky language, suggests redlines, and drafts new clauses from playbooks (docusign-docs-20, -25, -28), CLM's AI flags non-compliant clauses and suggests approved language (docusign-docs-16), and AI-Assisted Summary/Q&A over agreements (docusign-docs-2). These are first-party documented but lack independent/hands-on validation of output quality.

missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence confirming AI suggestion/insight quality and accuracy, no community corroboration of these specific AI features.
